newsitem.title: UK: RUGBY UNION-Harlequins may snare Zinny, M.Jones - paper.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-Harlequins may snare Zinny, M.Jones - paper.

text.p: LONDON, Sept 18 - All Blacks Zinzan Brooke and Michael Jones are poised to sign contracts with London rugby club Harlequins, according to the Daily Mail, NZPA reported on Thursday (NZT).
The two-year contracts are rumoured to be worth 150,000 stg ($NZ339,670) each and also include accommodation, cars and bonuses.
But Harlequins' media liaison officer Alex Saward refused to confirm that Brooke and Jones would join fellow Kiwi Henry Paul in the top London club.
"I won't comment until a contract is signed, but I will say we'd love to have them both," he told NZPA.
